about: Every web address written into the shipped app (apps/desktop and crates source, tauri.conf.json, index.html). scripts/check-links.mjs fails on an address that is not listed here and on a listed address that no longer appears. `prefix: true` entries cover every address that starts with them. `online: true` addresses are fetched by `node scripts/check-links.mjs --online` before a build (ADR-0030 decision 6). Addresses a writer types (Idea Vault links, mood board links) are not listed: they are the writer's own.

addresses.why: Offered when the WebView2 runtime is missing (distribution.rs); the user chooses to open it.
JSON schema reference in tauri.conf.json for editors; the app never opens it.
Vite development server (devUrl); not used by release builds.
Tauri IPC origin in the content security policy; local to the app, never the network.
Local asset protocol for project images (asset_scope.rs and the content security policy); never the network.
The Straft AI model download after the person's click (download.rs, fetch.rs; ADR-0032): the pinned files at fixed commits, redirects only to huggingface.co or *.hf.co.
Opened in the browser when the person chooses Contact us; the app sends nothing.
The local llama.cpp server the app starts on a random loopback port (supervisor.rs); never leaves the computer.
XML namespace names written inside exported DOCX files (docx.rs); identifiers, never fetched.
Dublin Core namespace name inside exported DOCX files (docx.rs); an identifier, never fetched.
